## Do not edit this folder

This is the clean-room replication record for Baqaee–Farhi (2020/2022), AER
(COVID-19 application). It is retained for reference; it is **not** the base
model for the closure paper (see DE-0007).

Known open items at freeze (see `registry/freeze.toml`): two of six HtM
sweep cells reconstructed rather than converged, Route B (JuMP +
PATHSolver) not implemented, and the README/VALIDATION disagreement on HtM
convergence.

Sources: `README.md`, `VALIDATION.md`, `POTENTIAL_OUTLOOK.md`,
`archive/STATUS.md`.
